_doc: Pre-approvals the operator granted in advance, so a human tap is not needed for these exact cases. Each is bounded by action, size and expiry, and is only usable when the strategy's own trigger fires. Recorded in decisions.

approvals.conditions: lp-manage trigger only: LP out of range >= 60 min, 24h cooldown; slippage floor 0.5%; all recipients = wallet
lp-manage trigger only: LP out of range >= 60 min and fee run-rate under 15% APR
